text:
Nora G: Heads-up 1: we have a vendor invoice (ACME) that shows ~1,200 GPU-hours charged to customer project 'acme-prod' but our internal bill mapped ~900 of those to 'research-infra' due to tag mismatch. Customer is asking for clarification.

Sam T: Oof. Do we know if the source is the cloud export or our mapping layer?

Nora G: Quick grep of the last billing export shows invoice line: vendor_project=acme-prod, cloud_tag: customer_id=acme-corp, owner_team=NULL. Our allocation join uses owner_team first, then customer_id fallback. If owner_team is null we routed to "unallocated" which our downstream job later heuristically assigned to research-infra.

Lina M: That explains it. There's a known ETL NRT window where owner_team tags aren't populated for APAC resources (job billing-etl-apac-runner had a schema drift last week).

billing-bot: automated-alert: invoice_line_mismatch > 500 GPU-hours for external customer "acme-corp" on 2026-03-18 :warning:

Victor H: What's the impact to GL and to Acme's invoice? Do we owe them a credit or just internal reclassification?

Nora G: Two separate problems: 1) Acme sees charged usage under their invoice but support ticket says internal team billed some of it incorrectly. 2) Our internal chargeback reports show research-infra consumed more than reality

Suggested path: correct internal ledger entries to move the ~900 GPU-hours off research-infra back to "acme-corp" pending vendor confirmation, then request vendor invoice reissue if needed.

Sam T: Agree. Need a quick fix: run a backfill SQL that reassigns allocation based on cloud_tag.customer_id when owner_team is NULL for that date range. Then mark as provisional credit on research-infra ledger and raise vendor dispute.

Lina M: I can patch ETL to stop dropping owner_team in APAC; PR ready with test and backfill script: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/pulls/4981

Nora G: I've simulated the backfill on a snapshot: moving 912 GPU-hours changes research-infra monthly variance from +8% to +0.5% and increases acme-corp billed hours to match vendor invoice. CSV of sim attached in PR.

Victor H: Finance needs to approve provisional ledger adjustment. We should also capture audit trail and a memo for month-end close.

billing-bot: reminder: create a change request for ledger adjustments: https://internal.redwood/billing/change-requests ACCT-5567 created

Sam T: Proposed commands (one-off):
```
-- identify lines
SELECT * FROM billing.raw_lines WHERE invoice_id='INV-ACME-202603' AND owner_team IS NULL;
-- reassign
UPDATE billing.allocations SET customer_id='acme-corp', note='provisional reassign due to ETL apac tag drop' WHERE invoice_id='INV-ACME-202603' AND owner_team IS NULL;
```
Run under feature-flag and with dry-run first.

Lina M: I'll coordinate with Platform Oncall to run the backfill in staging then prod. PR includes dry-run outputs.

Nora G: VendorInvoicer: can you confirm if you'll reissue invoice if we return proof of mapping error? They asked for invoice IDs and amount.

VendorInvoicer: Yes, we can reissue. Please send invoice IDs + corrected allocation CSV and we'll generate a credit note by end of week.

Victor H: Finance provisional approval: we will post an internal reclassification credit to research-infra for the affected amount, mark it provisional in the ledger, and reverse if vendor doesn't reissue by month-end. Condition: 1) PR merged, 2) backfill dry-run validated, 3) vendor acknowledgement.

Nora G: Got it. I've attached the simulation CSV and audit diff in the PR. Next steps: Lina merge PR + schedule backfill, Sam run the dry-run and share logs, Victor will post provisional credit entry and notify month-end close team.

Sam T: Dry-run logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/billing/backfill/4981/dryrun -> no conflicts. Ready for prod when Platform gives greenlight.

Lina M: Platform validated canary on one invoice group. I'll run prod backfill tonight 02:00 UTC and post results.

billing-bot: note: ledger-adjustment-ticket ACCT-5567 updated to status=In Progress

Nora G: Thanks everyone. I'll reply to Acme support with the plan and expected timeline for a corrected invoice.

Victor H: Please cc finance ops on the customer note (finance-ops@internal).

Nora G: Will do. Closing thread once backfill completes and vendor confirms. :white_check_mark:
